decisions.reason: Identifies dsh web host node.exe PID 42432 as loading koffi.node, locked for the process lifetime so npm copy/replace fails with EBUSY.
Explains refresh only reloads the SPA while the host keeps the lock; gives ordered stop/verify/pinned-install/verify/restart steps without prescribing killing unrelated Node processes.
Explains bare spec follows latest (0.1.1-rc.2) while alpha is 0.1.2-alpha.5, silently downgrading from alpha.4; notes npm ignores the installed version.
Gives npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-alpha.5 with the TUI plugin after stopping the host; verifies dsh --version is alpha.5 and restarts. @alpha only as labeled alternative.
Recommends pinning the exact core version whenever an install command also installs dsh and warns against silently following latest over an existing prerelease.
